_comment: Canned replies, first match wins. match is a case-insensitive substring of the user message. tool and arguments follow the activity under test; arguments may use {{today}}, {{tomorrow}}, {{yesterday}} (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh). A reply is used only if its tool is among the request's tools; otherwise the next one is tried. Rows below the probe rows serve the pre-order pipeline test (k6/pipeline.js). Marker syntax in the message text overrides these rows, see README.
